product_metadata.title: InfiOne Olive Oil Dispenser Oil Sprayer for Cooking, Upgraded 7oz/200ml Olive Oil Spray Oil Mister, Glass Oil Dispenser Bottle for Kitchen BBQ Salad Baking Grilling Frying (White)
features: ✅【UPGRADED FOOD-GRADE GLASS OIL DISPENSER】: The cooking spray is designed to endure daily cooking use, adapt with food grade PP cap and high-temperature resistant glass body, BPA-free, 100% safe, and healthy. Equipped with 3 new detachable replaceable atomizing nozzles can get 100% even mist while keeping the nozzles clean and free of oil dripping from the nozzles and can adjust the spray angle by turning the nozzle, so as to control the spray effect of the edible olive oil mister.

✅【FUEL SAVING EXPERT&HEALTHY DIET】：Adjust the nozzle, press quickly to spray a fan-shaped mist, less oil consumption, and can evenly spray every part of the food, reducing the intake of oil and maintaining health. Compare with pulling oil into the food, it will save oil and help you control the calorie intake. (The nozzle is rotated, will be different spray effects. Press quickly you will get a foggy effect, halfway down will get a columnar effect.)

✅【LEAKPROOF & LARGE OPENING】：We redesigned the olive oil spray bottle and improved the screw interface. Multi-layer screw-interface design, it is now easier to open and close the top cap, the sealing is better now without leak. Its mouth is designed with a large diameter, which makes it easy to pour oil without the aid of a funnel. and the transparent bottle is easier to observe the usage of oil. The oil spray bottle is solid and Lightweight for single-handed use, and portable (7oz).

✅【MULTIFUNCTIONAL SPRAYER & EASY to CLEAN】：This oil sprayer for air fryer is the perfect tool for home & kitchen. it can add various condiments, such as olive oil, vinegar, lemon juice, red wine, soy sauce, etc. And widely used during salad making, Cooking, Baking, Grilling, BBQ, frying, and so on. It can also be used to spray alcohol and water to clean the kitchen and furniture, or used to water plants; After use, just add warm water and detergent, shake it gently and use water to clean it.

✅【NOTE&AFTER-SALES SUPPORT】：This cooking oil dispenser is a nice gift for dad, mom, family, relatives, friends, cooks and etc. 【Adjust the nozzle to the exact position. Quickly and forcefully press the handle of the spray bottle and it will spray a fan-shaped mist of oil. slow and light pressure will spray a "jet" stream or a straight shot】.
